description.value: Din Tai Fung is an internationally acclaimed Taiwanese restaurant chain renowned for its meticulously hand-folded xiao long bao, with this Vancouver location opening in May 2025 on the second floor of the Carmana Hotel building in downtown. The restaurant sits roughly 15 minutes on foot from the Canada Place cruise terminal and offers a full menu spanning dumplings, noodles, soups, and desserts, with explicit vegan and vegetarian options including vegan dumplings and wontons.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 32m; stands (2 spaces) at 47m; stands (12 spaces, covered) at 55m; stands (2 spaces) at 95m; rack (5 spaces) at 99m. Total: 26 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and corroborates OSM phone and address (adding postal code V6E 1A5). The Vancouver location FAQ and menu pages confirm takeout availability, vegetarian and vegan menu items, and that restrooms exist ('changing tables in all of our restrooms'). No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, Wi-Fi, device charging, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM opening_hours differ from the hours shown on the website; OSM data may be outdated.
OSM address lacks postal code; website provides V6E 1A5, used as the canonical address above.
No bike parking, rack, or cycling-amenity information found on website or in OSM tags — key WWC criterion unverifiable from available sources.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Din Tai Fung is a legitimate, actively operating food & drink establishment in downtown Vancouver with confirmed washrooms, takeout, and strong vegetarian/vegan options — all useful to touring cyclists. However, none of the bike-specific required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill) are confirmed from any available evidence, limiting confidence in its fit as a cycling-specific directory listing without further on-the-ground verification.
enrichment_extras.notes: Restaurant is located on the second floor of the Carmana Hotel building. No dedicated parking lot; website references paid parking structures within a 2-minute walk on Burrard and Alberni Streets.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website confirms vegetarian and vegan dishes (Vegan Dumplings, Vegan Spicy Wontons, Vegan Noodles, Vegetable and Mushroom Xiao Long Bao, etc.); menu page notes gluten-free dishes exist but cross-contact with allergens may occur due to shared equipment
